title: Sampled geometric aircraft candidate pass
description: ODbL-derived geometric candidates, not acoustic labels. Pass membership and the primary closest approach use observed samples only, requiring minimum observed slant <=10000 m in the recording's nominal UTC interval. Separate auxiliary interpolated_* fields use linear interpolation between supported brackets <=10 s apart, clipped to the recording interval; they do not change pass membership or the primary observed minimum. No speed or aircraft-type gate. Observer height and altitude reference approximations are explicit. No completeness claim.

aircraft_hash.description: SHA256 of UTF-8 org.geoloc.open-aircraft-passes.v1: plus lowercase trimmed ICAO. Public namespace, pseudonymization not anonymization; a public address can be enumerated.

closest_approach_utc.description: UTC of minimum observed slant sample, not interpolated continuous closest approach and not acoustic arrival time.

horizontal_distance_m.description: Haversine distance from unchanged released public observer position, sphere radius 6371008.8 m.

slant_distance_m.description: Hypotenuse of horizontal distance and aircraft altitude minus declared observer height; altitude/datum assumptions prevent a complete exact-range claim.

altitude_m.description: Aircraft altitude at the selected sample, feet converted by 0.3048; reference given in altitude_basis.

observer_elevation_m.description: Height used by geometry, including 0 when explicitly assumed, not a claim that source elevation was supplied.

ground_speed_m_s.description: Reported knots multiplied by 1852/3600, no minimum-speed selection.

aircraft_category.description: Type-catalogue description code, e.g. H2T or L1P; not a surveillance emitter category.

surveillance_sources.description: Reported raw source labels, e.g. adsb_icao, mlat, tisb_icao; unknown may be empty.

detector_found.description: Null unless an explicit aircraft-to-detector association is available; temporal coincidence is insufficient.

locator_used.description: Null unless an explicit aircraft-to-locator association is available.

interpolated_closest_approach_utc.description: Separate auxiliary minimum over supported <=10 s interpolation brackets, clipped to the recording interval; null if unsupported. Does not determine pass membership or replace the primary observed closest approach.

ground_status.description: Reported ground flag when retained by source; null when source did not preserve it. No ground filter added.

audibility_basis.description: One line: the measurement behind audible, or why it is null.

audible.description: Band rule audible-v1 (DATASHEET.md): true when 50 Hz-1 kHz energy at closest approach plus sound travel time is at least 3 dB above the median of the same recording's (or its neighbours') quiet 20 s windows; null when not scored or undetermined, with the reason in audibility_basis. Conservative against faint aircraft, but quiet decoy windows also flag (rate in data/audibility_summary.json).

audible_classifier.description: Independent check: PANNs CNN14 AudioSet aircraft classes call aircraft at closest approach; null when not scored.

audible_excess_db.description: Band excess in dB at closest approach over the quiet windows' median; null when not scored.
